name: Unwrap
summary: Customer-feedback intelligence platform (Unwrap.ai) that groups feedback into a taxonomy of Groups with volume and trend metrics. A first-party, read-only MCP server (nlp.api.production.unwrap.ai/mcp) exposes the same tools as its in-app Assistant; per its security FAQ, tools that classify or summarize sampled entries run an LLM server-side. Keyless initialize returned 401 Bearer on 2026-11-19. Unmeasured.

payments.notes: Pricing page: "Starting at $24,000 per year", by feedback volume and integrations, never per seat; a 30-day trial. Terms of Use (2026-11-18) s.7: Order Form fees invoiced in advance by email; ACH or wire fees are the customer's; card where that is the payment method. Not machine-payable.

agentAccess.notes: Needs an Unwrap account. Keyless POST initialize to nlp.api.production.unwrap.ai/mcp returned HTTP 401 Bearer, 2026-11-19. OAuth 2.1 + PKCE: per-user DCR, or an org admin's static client with client_credentials for machine-to-machine access. All advertised scopes are read scopes.

jobs.summary: Vendor-computed: search_groups and search_actionable_groups return taxonomy Groups (themes) and top issues; plot_chart gives volume over time; sample_feedback_entries returns entries; analyze_entry_text returns prevalence plus examples, run by an LLM server-side. Vendor docs, not measured.
